rule DataTableAntiJoinExample {
  meta:
    author = "example"
    description = "Alert on $e when no matching row exists in %excluded_hosts"
    severity = "MEDIUM"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION"

rule IngestionLatencyDataShape {
  meta:
    author      = "SecOps Team"
    description = "Computes 5-point quartile profile and Bowley skewness for log latency"
    severity    = "INFORMATIONAL"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds > 0
    $e.metadata.log_type != ""
    $log_type = $e.metadata.log_type

  match:
    $log_type over 5m

  outcome:
    $p10 = window.percentile($e.metadata.ingested_timestamp.seconds - $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds, 10)
    $p25 = window.percentile($e.metadata.ingested_timestamp.seconds - $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds, 25)
    $p50 = window.percentile($e.metadata.ingested_timestamp.seconds - $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds, 50)
    $p75 = window.percentile($e.metadata.ingested_timestamp.seconds - $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds, 75)
    $p90 = window.percentile($e.metadata.ingested_timestamp.seconds - $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds, 90)

    $iqr = $p75 - $p25
    $bowley_num = $p75 + $p25 - (2 * $p50)
    $safe_iqr = if($iqr > 0, $iqr, 1.0)
    $bowley_skew = $bowley_num / $safe_iqr

  condition:
    $e
}

rule ttp_azure_network_device_modified_edwin {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Azure Network Device Modified"
    description = "Detects the modification of an Azure Network Device."
    severity = "Info"
    tactic = "TA0005"
    technique = "T1562"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "AZURE_ACTIVITY"
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "Microsoft"
    $e.metadata.product_name = "Azure Activity"
    $e.security_result.action = "ALLOW" and
    (
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = "MICROSOFT.NETWORK/NETWORKINTERFACES/TAPCONFIGURATIONS/WRITE" or
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = "MICROSOFT.NETWORK/NETWORKINTERFACES/WRITE" or
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = "MICROSOFT.NETWORK/NETWORKINTERFACES/JOIN/ACTION" or
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = "MICROSOFT.NETWORK/NETWORKVIRTUALAPPLIANCES/WRITE" or
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = "MICROSOFT.NETWORK/VIRTUALHUBS/WRITE" or
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = "MICROSOFT.NETWORK/VIRTUALROUTERS/WRITE"
    )

    $principalAccountId = $e.principal.user.userid

  match:
    $principalAccountId over 6h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 10
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $event_types = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_event_type)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.target.resource.name)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)

rule test_vmware_vcenter_excessive_failed_logins {

  meta:
    author          = "SKAX SecOps"
    description      = "VMware vCenter에 24시간 동안 로그인 실패 100회를 초과한 사용자 탐지"
    rule_id         = "vmware_vcenter_user_bruteforce"
    severity        = "MEDIUM"
    priority        = "MEDIUM"
    mitre_tactic    = "TA0006"   // Credential Access
    mitre_technique = "T1110"    // Brute Force
    yara_version    = "YL2.0"
    rule_version    = "1.0"

  events:
    // 1) vCenter 로그인 이벤트 + 실패(BLOCK) 필터
    $e.metadata.event_type   = "USER_LOGIN"
    $e.metadata.vendor_name  = "VMware" nocase
    $e.metadata.product_name = /vCenter|vSphere/ nocase
    $e.security_result.action = "BLOCK"

    // 2) 집계 키: 로그인을 시도한 사용자
    $e.target.user.userid = $user
    $user != ""

  match:
    $user over 24h

  outcome:
    $failed_login_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $distinct_src_ips   = count_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $src_ip_list        = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $vcenter_targets    = array_distinct($e.target.hostname)

  condition:
    $e and $failed_login_count > 100
}

rule host_cumulative_risk_threshold_exceeded {
  meta:
    author = "tarahlewis"
    description = "Aggregates risk scores from ALL detections on a host, escalating when cumulative risk exceeds safety thresholds"
    severity = "Critical"

  events:
    $det.metadata.event_type = "STATUS_UPDATE"
    $det.target.hostname = $host
    $det.security_result.risk_score = $score

  match:
    $host over 14d

  outcome:
    $cumulative_risk = sum($score)

  condition:
    $det and $cumulative_risk >= 50
}

rule suspicious_process_launch_from_web_domain {
  meta:
    author = "tarahlewis"
    description = "Detects processes launched from suspicious domains extracted directly from command line arguments"
    severity = "High"
    mitre_attack_tactic = "Execution"
    mitre_attack_technique = "Command and Scripting Interpreter"

  events:
    $process.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    $process.principal.process.command_line = /powershell|cmd/ nocase

    // Extract a clean domain/IP from raw arguments using re.capture
    $clean_domain = re.capture($process.target.process.command_line, `https?:\/\/([a-zA-Z0-9\-\.]+)(?:\/|$)`)
    // Filter out internal Cymbal domains or check against a bad extension pattern
    $clean_domain != ""
    $clean_domain != /.*\.cymbalinvestments\.com/ nocase


  condition:
    $process and $clean_domain
}
rules.author: tarahlewis

rule EDR_and_Google_Workspace_Telemetry_Combination {
  meta:
    author = "Google Threat Intelligence"
    description = "Detects a potential account compromise or insider threat by correlating a suspicious file execution on an endpoint (EDR) with a sensitive action in Google Workspace (e.g., global setting change or bulk data export) performed by the same user within a short timeframe."
    severity = "High"
    technique = "T1078.004" // Valid Accounts: Cloud Accounts

  events:
    // Event 1: EDR Telemetry - Suspicious Process Execution
    $edr.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    $edr.principal.user.userid = $user_id
    $edr.target.process.file.full_path = /.*\\(powershell|cmd|wscript|cscript|certutil|bitsadmin)\.exe/ nocase
    
    // Event 2: Google Workspace Telemetry - Sensitive Admin or Data Action
    $workspace.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Cloud"
    $workspace.metadata.product_name = "Google Workspace"
    $workspace.target.user.userid = $user_id
    (
        $workspace.metadata.event_type = "USER_RESOURCE_ACCESS" or 
        $workspace.metadata.event_type = "RESOURCE_CREATION" or
        $workspace.metadata.event_type = "STATUS_UPDATE"
    )
    // Filter for sensitive Workspace actions like downloading data or changing settings
    (
        $workspace.metadata.product_event_type = "drive.download" or
        $workspace.metadata.product_event_type = "admin.global_setting_change" or
        $workspace.metadata.product_event_type = "login.suspicious_login"
    )

  match:
    $user_id over 1h

  condition:
    $edr and $workspace
}
rules.author: Google Threat Intelligence

rule ueba_excessive_alerting_per_device {

  meta:
    description = "Uses UEBA alert metrics to find hosts generating high numbers of alerts"
    severity = "Low"
    priority = "Low"

  events:
    //Note that you can't scope the alert metrics on rules that had MITRE labels
    //Because you are comparing historic data to the current stream, and the current stream
    //Can't filter on MITRE tactic while the historic data isn't filtered on them.
    
    $e1.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    $e1.principal.asset.hostname = $hostname
    $e1.security_result.rule_name = $vendalert

  match:
    $hostname over 1h

  outcome:
    $daily_event_count = count($e1.metadata.id)
    $max_daily_event_count = max(metrics.alert_event_name_count(
      period:1d, window:30d,
      metric:event_count_sum,
      agg:sum,
      principal.asset.hostname:$hostname, security_result.rule_name:$vendalert))  //minimum two filters; this one is a subset of 4 allowed filters

    // detection feedback  

        $historical_stddev = max(metrics.alert_event_name_count(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:stddev,
        principal.asset.hostname:$hostname, security_result.rule_name:$vendalert
    ))

    $historical_avg = max(metrics.alert_event_name_count(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:avg,
        principal.asset.hostname:$hostname, security_result.rule_name:$vendalert
        ))

    $historical_max = max(metrics.alert_event_name_count(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:max,
        principal.asset.hostname:$hostname, security_result.rule_name:$vendalert
    ))

    $historical_observations = max(metrics.alert_event_name_count(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:sum,
        principal.asset.hostname:$hostname, security_result.rule_name:$vendalert
        ))

    $df_asset = array_distinct($e1.principal.hostname)

  condition:
    $e1 and ($daily_event_count > $historical_max)
}

rule PROMPTFLUX_Composite_Thinking_Robot {
  meta:
    author = "josemarin@google.com"
    description = "CRITICAL SEVERITY: Detects high-confidence, multi-stage infections of the PROMPTFLUX malware family. PROMPTFLUX is a highly sophisticated VBScript dropper (often masquerading as a 'ScreenRec' installer) that utilizes a generative AI 'Thinking Robot' module to evade static analysis. This composite rule correlates three distinct attack phases occurring on a single host within a 1-hour window: 1) Persistence established via wscript.exe writing obfuscated code to the Windows Startup folder. 2) Execution behaviors indicating payload staging in the Temp directory or spreading to mapped network/removable drives. 3) An active C2 heartbeat connecting to the Google Gemini API (generativelanguage.googleapis.com) to dynamically request and rewrite its own source code. Immediate host isolation is recommended."
    tactics = "TA0002,TA0003,TA0008,TA0011"
    techniques = "T1059.005,T1547.001,T1091,T1071.001"
    severity = "CRITICAL"

  events:
    // 1. Ingest the Curated Rule Detection for the Startup Folder write
    $startup_drop.detection.detection.rule_id = "ur_550fcfc7-dc17-4793-881b-cf4490245f72"
    $hostname = $startup_drop.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.hostname

    // 2. Ingest our Custom Multi-Event Producer Rule for execution behavior
    $behavior_drop.detection.detection.rule_name = "Suspicious_Wscript_Dropper_Spreader"
    $hostname = $behavior_drop.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.hostname

    // 3. Raw Event: AI Command & Control (Gemini API Heartbeat)
    $ai_api.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION"
    $ai_api.target.hostname = "generativelanguage.googleapis.com"
    $ai_api.principal.process.file.full_path = /\\(wscript|cscript)\.exe$/ nocase
    $ai_api.principal.hostname = $hostname

  match:
    // Groups the three stages together if they happen within 1 hour on the same host
    $hostname over 1h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = max(95)
    
    // Extract C2 and forensic details for the analyst view
    $c2_endpoint = array_distinct($ai_api.target.hostname)
    
    // Pull the specific file paths that triggered the producer rules
    $startup_file_dropped = array_distinct($startup_drop.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.file.full_path)
    $dropped_or_copied_file = array_distinct($behavior_drop.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.file.full_path)

  condition:
    // Triggers an alert ONLY if the host exhibits all three stages of the attack
    $startup_drop and $behavior_drop and $ai_api
}
rules.author: josemarin@google.com

rule Suspicious_Wscript_Dropper_Spreader {
  meta:
    author = "josemarin@google.com"
    description = "Multi-event rule detecting wscript.exe executing and subsequently dropping an executable in the Temp folder or spreading VBScripts to network/removable drives."
    severity = "MEDIUM"

  events:
    // Event 1: The Script Engine Execution
    $exec.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    $exec.target.process.file.full_path = /\\(wscript|cscript)\.exe$/ nocase
    $hostname = $exec.principal.hostname
    
    // Capture the PID so we can link it to the subsequent actions
    $process_pid = $exec.target.process.pid

    // Event 2: Suspicious Behavior tied to that exact script process
    $action.principal.hostname = $hostname
    $action.principal.process.pid = $process_pid

    (
      // Behavior A (Dropper): Creating an executable in the Temp directory
      (
        $action.metadata.event_type = "FILE_CREATION" and
        $action.target.file.full_path = /\\Temp\\[^\\]+\.exe$/ nocase
      )
      or
      // Behavior B (Spreader): Copying a VBScript to a network share (\\) or non-C: drive
      // Note: Standard regex is used here to identify external drives and UNC paths.
      (
        $action.metadata.event_type = "FILE_COPY" and
        $action.target.file.full_path = /^(\\\\|[d-zD-Z]:\\).*\.vbs$/ nocase
      )
    )

  match:
    $hostname over 5m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = max(50)
    $action_type = array_distinct($action.metadata.event_type)
    $target_file = array_distinct($action.target.file.full_path)

  condition:
    $exec and $action
}
rules.author: josemarin@google.com

rule malicious_mcp_server_activity {

  meta:
    author = "SecOps Advanced Threat Research"
    description = "CRITICAL PATHWAY: Detection of Remote Code Execution (RCE) via Model Context Protocol (MCP) Tool Injection. The adversary is using command chaining (semicolons/pipes) within MCP session parameters to break out of the LLM application sandbox. This indicates an attempt to execute arbitrary shell commands directly on the host serving the MCP resources."
    severity = "CRITICAL"

    $gti.graph.metadata.source_labels["is_reviewed"] = "true"))





  match:

    $e and $gti
}

rule clop_oracle_ebs_exploitation_recon {
  meta:
    author = "Google Threat Intelligence"
    description = "Detects CL0P ransomware group reconnaissance commands on Oracle EBS following CVE-2025-61882 exploitation. Targets find commands searching for sensitive documents run by the application user from an Oracle Java process."
    severity = "High"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1190, T1059.004, T1083"
    reference = "[collection:vulnerability--cve-2025-61882]"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    
    // Principal user is the standard Oracle EBS application manager
    $e.principal.user.userid = "applmgr"
    
    // Parent process is typically the Oracle Java process exploited via CVE-2025-61882
    $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /java/ nocase

    // Detects reconnaissance commands searching for sensitive enterprise data
    (
      $e.target.process.command_line = /find.*\.xlsx/ nocase or
      $e.target.process.command_line = /find.*\.pdf/ nocase or
      $e.target.process.command_line = /find.*\.docx/ nocase or
      $e.target.process.command_line = /find.*\.rar/ nocase
    )

}

rule ioc_safebrowsing {

  internal_meta:
    rule_id = "4b8bcc8e-6861-459f-95be-3ef13c45c4f2"
    author = "Uppercase"
    uc_author = "mosesschwartz"
    strategy = ""
    type = "experimental"
    data_source = "Safe Browsing Threat Feed"
    platform = "multiplatform"
    reference = "https://cloud.google.com/chronicle/docs/detection/use-enriched-data-in-rules#using_safe_browsing_enriched_fields_in_rules"
    uc_notify = "buganizer"
    uc_escalation_notify = "buganizer"

  customer_meta:
    rule_name = "GCTI Threat Feed: Safe Browsing File Match"
    description = "Simple Safe Browsing IOC Feed straight from the Chronicle docs."
    severity = "Low"

  events:
    // find a process launch event, match on hostname
    $execution.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    $execution.target.process.file.sha256 != ""
    $execution.principal.hostname = $hostname

    // join execution event with Safe Browsing graph
    $sb.graph.entity.file.sha256 = $execution.target.process.file.sha256

    // look for files deemed malicious
    $sb.graph.metadata.entity_type = "FILE"
    //$sb.graph.metadata.threat.severity = "CRITICAL"
    $sb.graph.metadata.product_name = "Google Safe Browsing"

    //prevalence entity graph lookup
    //$sb.graph.entity.file.prevalence.rolling_max <= 10


  match:
    $hostname over 5m

  condition:
    $execution and $sb
}

rule ioc_hash_prevalence {

  meta:
    author = "Google Cloud Security"
    description = "Detect process/file events that match hashes found in our MISP instance and have low rolling max prevalence"
    type = "alert"
    tags = "prevalence, threat indicators"
    assumption = "Assumes MISP data has been ingested into entity graph; this rule can be modified to utilize other TI indicators"
    data_source = "microsoft sysmon"
    severity = "High"
    priority = "High"

  events:
    $process.metadata.base_labels.namespaces = "LogStory"
    $process.metadata.event_type = "FILE_CREATION" or $process.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    $process.target.process.file.sha256 = $sha256

    // derived from events ingested by Chronicle
    $prevalence.graph.metadata.entity_type = "FILE"
    $prevalence.graph.metadata.source_type = "DERIVED_CONTEXT"
    $prevalence.graph.entity.file.prevalence.day_count = 10
    $prevalence.graph.entity.file.prevalence.rolling_max <= 3
    $prevalence.graph.entity.file.prevalence.rolling_max > 0
    $prevalence.graph.entity.file.sha256 = $sha256  

    // Correlates with MISP data; can be modified based on your MISP parser or other TI
    $ioc.graph.metadata.entity_type = "FILE"
    $ioc.graph.metadata.source_type = "ENTITY_CONTEXT"
    $ioc.graph.metadata.product_name = "MISP"
    $ioc.graph.entity.file.sha256 = $sha256

  match:
    $sha256 over 5m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = max(85)
    $event_count = count_distinct($process.metadata.id)
    // added to populate alert graph with additional context
    $principal_hostname = array_distinct($process.principal.hostname)
    $principal_process_pid = array_distinct($process.principal.process.pid)
    $principal_process_command_line = array_distinct($process.principal.process.command_line)
    $principal_process_file_sha256 = array_distinct($process.principal.process.file.sha256)
    $principal_process_file_full_path = array_distinct($process.principal.process.file.full_path)
    $principal_process_product_specfic_process_id = array_distinct($process.principal.process.product_specific_process_id)
    $principal_process_parent_process_product_specfic_process_id = array_distinct($process.principal.process.parent_process.product_specific_process_id)
    $target_process_pid = array_distinct($process.target.process.pid)
    $target_process_command_line = array_distinct($process.target.process.command_line)
    // Commented out target.process.file.sha256 because it is already represented in graph as match variable. If match changes, can uncomment to add to results
    $target_process_file_sha256 = array_distinct($process.target.process.file.sha256)
    $target_process_file_full_path = array_distinct($process.target.process.file.full_path)
    $target_process_product_specfic_process_id = array_distinct($process.target.process.product_specific_process_id)
    $principal_user_userid = array_distinct($process.principal.user.userid)
    $target_file_sha256 = array_distinct($process.target.file.sha256)
    $target_file_full_path = array_distinct($process.target.file.full_path)

  condition:
    $process and $ioc and $prevalence
}

rule APT34_Updated_Toolset_Intezer {
  meta:
    author = "Edwin Betancourth"
    description = "Detects TTPs and IOCs associated with an Iranian campaign by APT34 (OilRig) as described in an Intezer blog post. The campaign utilizes malicious documents, updated backdoors like SideTwist, and DNS tunneling for C2 communication."
    severity = "HIGH"
    priority = "HIGH"
    mitre_attack_tactic = "TA0011, TA0007, TA0002"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1566.001, T1071.004, T1547.001"

  events:
    // Event 1: Malicious local activity (file creation/modification OR process launch)
    (
      // File-based indicators
      (
        (
          $activity.metadata.event_type = "FILE_CREATION" or
          $activity.metadata.event_type = "FILE_MODIFICATION"
        ) and
        (
          $activity.principal.process.file.sha256 = "c10cd1c78c180ba657e3921ee9421b9abd5b965c4cdfaa94a58e383b45bb72ca" or
          $activity.principal.process.file.sha256 = "4c323bc11982b95266732c01645c39618550e68f25c34f6d3d79288eae7d4378" or
          $activity.principal.process.file.sha256 = "a897164e3547f0ce3aaa476b0364a200769e8c07ce825bcfdc43939dd1314bb1" or
          $activity.principal.process.file.sha256 = "20b3d046ed617b7336156a64a0550d416afdd80a2c32ce332be6bbfd4829832c" or
          $activity.principal.process.file.sha256 = "d61eecd7492dfa461344076a93fc2668dc28943724190faf3d9390f8403b6411" or
          $activity.principal.process.file.sha256 = "47d3e6c389cfdbc9cf7eb61f3051c9f4e50e30cf2d97499144e023ae87d685d5" // SideTwist backdoor
        )
      )
      or
      // Process-based indicators
      (
        $activity.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" and
        (
          $activity.principal.process.file.full_path = /clientupdate\.exe/ or
          $activity.principal.process.command_line = /Job-Details\.doc/
        )
      )
    )
    $hostname = $activity.principal.hostname

    // Event 2: Network communication to known C2 domains
    (
      $network.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_DNS" and
      (
        $network.network.dns.questions.name = /manygoodnews\.com/ or
        $network.network.dns.questions.name = /sarmsoftware\.com/
      )
    )
    $hostname = $network.principal.hostname

  match:
    $hostname over 5m

  condition:
    $activity and $network
}

rule my_own_rule {
  meta:
    author = "Google SecOps Gemini"
    description = "Detects the use of reg.exe to disable the Event Tracing for Windows (ETW) Autologger session for Windows Defender API and Audit events. By setting the 'Start' value to '0' for the 'DefenderApiLogger' or 'DefenderAuditLogger' session, an attacker can prevent these critical security events from being logged, effectively blinding monitoring tools that rely on this data. This is a powerful defense evasion technique."
    severity = "High"
  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    strings.ends_with($e.principal.process.file.full_path, "\\reg.exe")
    (
      re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, `\\Control\\WMI\\Autologger\\DefenderApiLogger\\Start`) OR
      re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, `\\Control\\WMI\\Autologger\\DefenderAuditLogger\\Start`)
    )
    re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, `add`) AND re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, `0`)
    NOT re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, `0x00000001`)
  outcome:
    $cmdline = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $user = $e.principal.user.userid
    $hostname = $e.principal.hostname
  condition:
    $e
}

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.product_name)
    $risk_score = max(
      if(any $e1.security_result.severity = "CRITICAL", 95, 0) +
      if(any $e1.security_result.severity = "HIGH", 85, 0) +
      if(any $e1.security_result.severity = "MEDIUM", 65, 0) +
      if(any $e1.security_result.severity = "LOW", 35, 0) +
      if(any $e1.security_result.severity = "INFORMATIONAL", 10, 0)
    )
    $threat_category = array_distinct($e1.metadata.product_event_type)
    $scc_product = array_distinct($e1.metadata.description)
    $severity = array_distinct($e1.security_result.severity)
    $url_back_to_product = array_distinct($e1.security_result.url_back_to_product)
    $event_count = 1

    $result_time = min($e1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e1.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e1.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e1.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e1
}

rule disabling_windows_defender_wmi_autologger_session_via_reg_exe {
  meta:
    author = "Google SecOps Gemini"
    description = "Detects the use of reg.exe to disable the Event Tracing for Windows (ETW) Autologger session for Windows Defender API and Audit events. By setting the 'Start' value to '0' for the 'DefenderApiLogger' or 'DefenderAuditLogger' session, an attacker can prevent these critical security events from being logged, effectively blinding monitoring tools that rely on this data. This is a powerful defense evasion technique."
    severity = "High"
  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    strings.ends_with($e.principal.process.file.full_path, "\\reg.exe")
    (
      re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, `\\Control\\WMI\\Autologger\\DefenderApiLogger\\Start`) OR
      re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, `\\Control\\WMI\\Autologger\\DefenderAuditLogger\\Start`)
    )
    re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, `add`) AND re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, `0`)
    NOT re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, `0x00000001`)
  outcome:
    $cmdline = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $user = $e.principal.user.userid
    $hostname = $e.principal.hostname
  condition:
    $e
}

rule monitored_user_google_workspace_file_shared_from_google_drive_to_free_email_domain {
    meta:
        author = "Google Cloud Security"
        description = "Identifies when a user account that is on our list of monitored users shares a file that's stored on Google Drive with a free email domain."
    
    events:
        $workspace.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Workspace"
        $workspace.metadata.product_name = "drive"

        (
            $workspace.metadata.product_event_type = "change_user_access" or
            $workspace.metadata.product_event_type = "change_document_visibility" or
            $workspace.metadata.product_event_type = "change_document_access_scope" or
            $workspace.metadata.product_event_type = "change_acl_editors"
        )

        // File shared with an email address that's associated with free email service
        // This list of domains can be customized and/or stored & maintained in its own data table
        $workspace.target.resource.attribute.labels["visibility"] = "shared_externally"
        $workspace.target.user.email_addresses = /.*@gmail\\.com|.*@aol\\.com|.*@ymail\\.com|.*@ymail\\.com|.*@hotmail\\.com|.*@outlook\\.com|.*@icloud\\.com/

        $user_email = $workspace.principal.user.email_addresses[0]
        // Check if the user's email address is found in a row within the data table's 'user_email' column
        $user_email = %monitored_users.user_email
    
        // Ensure that the event timestamp is earlier than the 'expiry_date' that's stored for the user in the data table
        $workspace.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds < timestamp.as_unix_seconds(%monitored_users.expiry_date)

    match:
        $user_email over 15m

    outcome:
        $target_emails = array_distinct($workspace.target.user.email_addresses)
        $doc_name = array_distinct($workspace.target.resource.name)

    condition:
        $workspace
}

    severity = "Medium"
 
  events:
    $rid = $d.detection.detection.rule_id

    $targets = $d.detection.detection.outcomes["Target_Domains"]

rule rule_web_hacking_spreading {

  meta:
    author = "Google"
    description = "Hacking into a WEB application and spreading to the internal network"
    severity = "High"

  events:
    $webserver.metadata.log_type = "F5_WAF"
    $webserver.security_result.severity = "CRITICAL"
    ($webserver.metadata.product_event_type = "SQL Injection" OR  $webserver.metadata.product_event_type = "RCE")
    $webserver.principal.hostname = $web_server_name
    $webserver.principal.ip = $web_server_ip

    $process.metadata.log_type = "WINDOWS_SYSMON"
    $process.metadata.product_event_type = "1"
    ($process.principal.process.file.full_path = /.*w3wp\.exe/ or $process.principal.process.file.full_path = /.*httpd\.exe/)
    ($process.target.process.file.full_path = /.*cmd\.exe/ or $process.target.process.file.full_path = /.*powershell\.exe/)
    $process.principal.hostname = $web_server_name

    ($network.metadata.log_type = "PAN_FIREWALL" or $network.metadata.log_type = "CORELIGHT") //sourcetype
    $network.security_result.action != "BLOCK" //action
    $network.security_result.category_details = "internal" //dest_ip_category
    $network.principal.ip = $web_server_ip

   $network.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds > $process.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
   $process.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds > $webserver.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds

  match:
    $web_server_ip over 1h
  outcome:
  $timestamp_process = array_distinct($process.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
  $timestamp_webserver = array_distinct($webserver.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
  $timestamp_network = array_distinct($network.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
  $web_server_ips = array_distinct($webserver.principal.ip)
  $web_server_names = array_distinct($process.principal.hostname)
  $Image = array_distinct($process.target.process.file.full_path)
  $ParentImage = array_distinct($process.principal.process.file.full_path)
  $distinct_ports = count_distinct($network.target.port)
  $distinct_hosts = count_distinct($network.target.ip)

  condition:
    $process and $network and $webserver and ($distinct_ports > 10 or $distinct_hosts > 10)
}

rule vt_threat_feed_domain_dga {

  meta:
    author = "cmmartin@"
    description = "This rule detects network connections that is also present in VirusTotal's categorized threat intelligence feeds that have been updated within the last 24 hours and are tagged as 'dga', 'potential-c2', or 'self-signed'."
    severity = "LOW"
    priorit = "MEDIUM"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION"
    $e.principal.ip = $principalIp
    not $e.target.ip in cidr %cidr_rfc_1918 
    $e.target.hostname = $domainName

    $vt_threat_feed.graph.entity.file.tags = $tag
    $vt_threat_feed.graph.metadata.entity_type = "DOMAIN_NAME"
    $vt_threat_feed.graph.metadata.product_name = "Categorized Threat Lists"
    $vt_threat_feed.graph.entity.hostname = $domainName
    $lastModificationTime = timestamp.get_timestamp($vt_threat_feed.graph.entity.file.last_modification_time.seconds)

  match:
    $principalIp over 1m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $tagsCheck1 = max(if($tag="dga",1,0))
    $tagsCheck2 = max(if($tag="potential-c2",1,0))
    $tagsCheck3 = max(if($tag="self-signed",1,0))  
    $tagThreshold = ($tagsCheck1 + $tagsCheck2 + $tagsCheck3)
    $recentlyModifiedDelta = max( timestamp.current_seconds() - $vt_threat_feed.graph.entity.file.last_modification_time.seconds )
    $wasRecentlyModified = if($recentlyModifiedDelta < 86400,1,0)

  condition:
    $e 
    and $vt_threat_feed 
    and $wasRecentlyModified = 1  // last modified within 24 hours
    and $tagThreshold > 0 // at least one specified tag was observed

}

rule demoverse_suspicious_auth_unusual_interval_time2 {

    meta:
        author = "@cmmartin"
        description = "Changing something Generates a detection for authentication activity occuring between two locations in an unusual interval of time."
        severity = "LOW"
        priority = "LOW"

    events:
        $e1.metadata.log_type = "WORKSPACE_ACTIVITY"
        $e1.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
        $e1.metadata.product_event_type = "login_success"
        
        // match variables
        $user = $e1.security_result.about.email
        $e1_lat = $e1.principal.location.region_coordinates.latitude
        $e1_long = $e1.principal.location.region_coordinates.longitude

        // ensure consistent event sequencing, i.e., $e1 is before $e2
        $e1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds < $e2.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
        // check the $e1 and $e2 coordinates represent different locations
        $e1_lat != $e2_lat
        $e1_long != $e2_long

        $e2.metadata.log_type = "WORKSPACE_ACTIVITY"
        $e2.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"    
        $e2.metadata.product_event_type = "login_success"
        // match variables
        $user = $e2.security_result.about.email
        $e2_lat = $e2.principal.location.region_coordinates.latitude
        $e2_long = $e2.principal.location.region_coordinates.longitude
    
    match:
        $user, 
        $e1_lat, 
        $e1_long, 
        $e2_lat, 
        $e2_long 
        over 4h
    
    outcome:
        // calculate the interval between first and last event, in seconds
        $duration_hours = cast.as_int(
            min(
                ($e2.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - $e1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds) 
                / 3600
            )
        )

        // calculate distance between login events, and convert results into kilometers
        // - math.ceil rounds up a float up to the nearest int
        $distance_kilometers = math.ceil(
            max(
                math.geo_distance(
                    $e1_long,
                    $e1_lat,
                    $e2_long,
                    $e2_lat
                )
            ) 
            // convert the math.geo_distance result from meters to kilometers
            / 1000 
        )

        // calculate the speed in KPH
        $kph = math.ceil($distance_kilometers / $duration_hours)

        // // generate risk_score based on KPH, i.e., speed over distance travelled
        $risk_score = (
            if($kph >= 100 and $kph <= 249, 35) +
            if($kph > 250 and $kph <= 449, 50) +
            if($kph > 500 and $kph <= 999, 75) +
            if($kph >= 1000, 90)
        ) 

        // change this according to your requirements
        $risk_score_threshold = 75
    
    condition:
        $e1 and $e2// and $risk_score >= $risk_score_threshold
}

rule non_interactive_powershell_process_spawned {
 meta:
    author = "Roberto Rodriguez @Cyb3rWard0g (rule), oscd.community (improvements)"
    description = "Detects non-interactive PowerShell activity by looking at the \"powershell\" process with a non-user GUI process such as \"explorer.exe\" as a parent.."
    license = "https://github.com/Neo23x0/sigma/blob/master/LICENSE.Detection.Rules.mdcommunity (improvements)."
    reference = "https://web.archive.org/web/20200925032237/https://threathunterplaybook.com/notebooks/windows/02_execution/WIN-190410151110.html"
    version = "0.01"
    sigma_id = "f4bbd493-b796-416e-bbf2-121235348529"
    status = "test"
    tags = "attack.execution, attack.t1059.001"
    falsepositives = "Likely. Many admin scripts and tools leverage PowerShell in their BAT or VB scripts which may trigger this rule often. It is best to add additional filters or use this to hunt for anomalies"
    severity = "low"
    created = "2019-09-12"
    category = "process_creation"
    product = "windows"

  events:
    $selection.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" and 
    (((re.regex($selection.target.process.file.full_path, `.*\\powershell\.exe`) nocase or 
    re.regex($selection.target.process.file.full_path, `.*\\pwsh\.exe`) nocase)) or 
    (($selection.target.file.full_path = "PowerShell.EXE" nocase or $selection.target.file.full_path = "pwsh.dll" nocase))) and 
    not (((re.regex($selection.principal.process.file.full_path, `.*:\\Windows\\explorer\.exe`) nocase or 
    re.regex($selection.principal.process.file.full_path, `.*:\\Windows\\System32\\CompatTelRunner\.exe`) nocase or 
    re.regex($selection.principal.process.file.full_path, `.*:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\explorer\.exe`) nocase)) or 
    ($selection.principal.process.file.full_path = ":\\$WINDOWS.~BT\\Sources\\SetupHost.exe" nocase)) and 
    not ((re.regex($selection.principal.process.file.full_path, `.*\\AppData\\Local\\Programs\\Microsoft VS Code\\Code\.exe`) nocase and 
    re.regex($selection.principal.process.command_line, `.* --ms-enable-electron-run-as-node .*`) nocase) or 
    (re.regex($selection.principal.process.file.full_path, `.*:\\Program Files\\WindowsApps\\Microsoft\.WindowsTerminal_.*`) nocase and 
    re.regex($selection.principal.process.file.full_path, `.*\\WindowsTerminal\.exe`) nocase))

  condition:
    $selection
}

rule dt_process_outside_of_known_department {

  meta:

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    $process = re.capture($e.principal.process.file.full_path,`^.*\\(.*?)$`)
    $process != ""
    $department = $e.principal.user.department
    $department != ""
    (
        $process = %test_008.process
        and not $department in %test_008.departments
    )

    match:
        $process, $department over 1d

    outcome:
        $risk_score = 0
        $dt_process = array_distinct(%test_008.process)
        $dt_department = array_distinct(%test_008.departments)
        $analysis = array_distinct(strings.concat("The process ",$process," was observed running in a previously unseen department: ",$department))

    condition:
        $e
}

rule dt_ua_not_in_baseline {

  meta:

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    $user = $e.principal.user.userid

    $ip = $e.principal.ip

    not $e.principal.ip in %BASELINE_AUTH_WITH_USER_AGENT.ip

    not $e.network.http.user_agent in %BASELINE_AUTH_WITH_USER_AGENT.userAgent

        $user, $userAgent over 5m

        $risk_score = 
        (
            if(

            ) //+        
        )

  condition:
    $e

}

    // Example: C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe -> cmd.exe
    $process = re.capture($e.target.process.file.full_path,`^.*\\([^$]+)$`)

    // Extract the directory path (e.g., "\Windows\System32\") from the full path.
    // Example: C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe -> \Windows\System32\
    $path = re.capture($e.target.process.file.full_path,`^.*?(\\.*\\)[^$]+$`)

    // Check if the extracted process name is a known LOLBAS (case-insensitive).
    $process = %LOLBAS1.Filename nocase

    $command_line_arguments = re.capture($e.principal.process.command_line,`^.*?\.exe\s(.*)$`)
    $command_line_arguments != ""

  match:
    $host over 1m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $LOLBAS_process = arrays.index_to_str(array_distinct($process),0)
    $LOLBAS_cli = arrays.index_to_str(array_distinct($command_line_arguments),0)
    //$cli_hash = array_distinct(hash.sha256($command_line_arguments))
    $LOLBAS_cli_fingerprint = arrays.index_to_str(array_distinct(hash.fingerprint2011($command_line_arguments)),0)
    $LOLBAS_cli_entropy = arrays.index_to_str(array_distinct(math.floor(strings.shannon_entropy($command_line_arguments))),0)

  condition:
    $e

  export:
    %LOLBAS_CLI.write_row(
        //LOLBAS_process,LOLBAS_cli,LOLBAS_cli_fingerprint,LOLBAS_cli_entropy
        LOLBAS_process:$LOLBAS_process,
        LOLBAS_cli:$LOLBAS_cli,
        LOLBAS_cli_fingerprint:$LOLBAS_cli_fingerprint,
        LOLBAS_cli_entropy:$LOLBAS_cli_entropy
    )

}

rule domain_prevalence_whois_30d {

  meta:
    author = "Google Cloud Security"
    description = "Detects DNS events querying domains that have a low rolling max prevalence to a new domain."
    type = "alert"
    tags = "prevalence"
    data_source = "EDR, DNS, Entity Graph"
    severity = "Low"
    priority = "Low"

  events:
    $dns.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_DNS"
    $dns.network.dns.questions.name = $domain

    // derived from events ingested by Chronicle
    $prevalence.graph.metadata.entity_type = "DOMAIN_NAME"
    $prevalence.graph.metadata.source_type = "DERIVED_CONTEXT"
    $prevalence.graph.entity.hostname = $domain
    $prevalence.graph.entity.domain.prevalence.day_count = 10
    $prevalence.graph.entity.domain.prevalence.day_max = 5
    $prevalence.graph.entity.domain.prevalence.rolling_max <= 3
    $prevalence.graph.entity.domain.prevalence.rolling_max > 0
 //   $prevalence.graph.entity.domain.prevalence.rolling_max_sub_domains <= 2

    // Whois domains provided by GCTI Feed
    $whois.graph.entity.domain.name = $domain
    $whois.graph.metadata.entity_type = "DOMAIN_NAME"
    $whois.graph.metadata.vendor_name = "WHOIS"
    $whois.graph.metadata.product_name = "WHOISXMLAPI Simple Whois"
    $whois.graph.metadata.source_type = "GLOBAL_CONTEXT"
    $whois.graph.entity.domain.creation_time.seconds > 0

    // domain was created in the last 30 days
    2592000 > timestamp.current_seconds() - $whois.graph.entity.domain.creation_time.seconds

  match:
    $domain over 1d

  outcome:
    $risk_score = max(35)
    $event_count = count_distinct($dns.metadata.id)
    $network_dns_questions_name = array_distinct($dns.network.dns.questions.name)
    $network_dns_answers_data = array_distinct($dns.network.dns.answers.data)
    // added to populate alert graph with additional context
    $principal_ip = array_distinct($dns.principal.ip)
    $target_ip = array_distinct($dns.target.ip)
    $principal_process_pid = array_distinct($dns.principal.process.pid)
    $principal_process_file_full_path = array_distinct($dns.principal.process.file.full_path)
    $principal_process_product_specfic_process_id = array_distinct($dns.principal.process.product_specific_process_id)
    $principal_process_command_line = array_distinct($dns.principal.process.command_line)
    $principal_process_file_sha256 = array_distinct($dns.principal.process.file.sha256)
    $principal_process_parent_process_product_specfic_process_id = array_distinct($dns.principal.process.parent_process.product_specific_process_id)
    $principal_user_userid = array_distinct($dns.principal.user.userid)


  condition:
    $dns and $prevalence and $whois
}

rule windows_unclassified_binary_with_high_entropy {

  meta:
    author = "@cmmartin"
    description = "Detects proceses above a specified Shannon Entropy level"
    severity = "LOW"
    reference = ""
    alerting = "false"
    tactic = "TA0011" //Command and Control 
    technique = "T1102" //Web Service" 
    composite_detection_input = "true"
    composite_detection_category = "windows_process"

  events:
    $hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    //$hostname = "DESKTOP-ET51AJO" nocase
    $process_path = re.capture($e.principal.process.file.full_path,`^(.*)\\`)
    $process = re.capture($e.principal.process.file.full_path,`^.*\\(.*?)$`)
    $hash = $e.principal.process.file.md5 
    $entropy = strings.shannon_entropy(re.capture($e.principal.process.file.full_path,`^.*\\(.*?)$`))
    $entropy >= 3

    $g.graph.metadata.source_type = "GLOBAL_CONTEXT"
    $g.graph.entity.file.md5 = $hash
    $g.graph.metadata.threat.threat_feed_name = "Benign Binaries"

  match:
    $hostname, $process_path, $process over 10m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = max(10)
    $max_entropy = max(strings.shannon_entropy(re.capture($e.principal.process.file.full_path,`^.*\\(.*?)$`)))

  condition:
    $e and !$g

}

rule arg_unc3944_cli_3 {
    internal_meta:
    type = "customer_alert"
    author = "Uppercase"
    uc_author = "jpetropoulos"
    internal_source = "mdnt_spear, rulegen"
    data_source = "EDR logs"
    labels = "generator=rulegen,strategy=common_strings,project=augment_with_intel"
    platform = "Windows"
    strategy = "Generated rule. Identify suspicious encoded powershell commands related to priority APTs sourced from Mgraph data. Iteratively review rules and update F1 query, rule gen strategy, and the rule template to tune the rules."
    reference = "go/awi_unc3944"
    slot_usage = "0.0011"
    rule_id = "93e4234d-d456-4b8d-9353-ae35f84ff736"

  customer_meta:
    description = "Detects the use of SSH to create a reverse tunnel as root, forwarding a local port (3389 for RDP) to a remote host. This is often used by attackers to bypass firewalls and gain unauthorized access to internal systems."
    rule_name = "UNC3944 SSH Reverse Tunnel Root"
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1059"
    reference = "https://advantage.mandiant.com/actors/threat-actor--8824cd44-bc42-581b-8261-22425265609e"

  events:
    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    // Matching indicators similar to: ^ssh -R IPv4:12345:localhost:3389 root@IPv4$
    re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, `ssh\s+-R\s+(?:(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)\.){3}(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?):\d+:localhost:3389\s+root`) nocase

    // Rule Chaining outcomes
    $adv_uid = strings.coalesce($e.principal.asset.product_object_id, $e.principal.asset.asset_id)
    $adv_netid = strings.coalesce($e.principal.asset.ip, $e.principal.asset.mac, $e.principal.ip, $e.principal.mac)
    $adv_name = strings.coalesce($e.principal.asset.hostname, $e.principal.hostname)
    $vic_uid = strings.coalesce($e.principal.user.product_object_id, $e.principal.user.employee_id)
    $vic_netid = strings.coalesce($e.principal.user.email_addresses, $e.principal.user.windows_sid)
    $vic_name = strings.coalesce($e.principal.user.userid, $e.principal.user.user_display_name)

  match:
    $principal_hostname over 5m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $vendor_name = array($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array($e.metadata.product_name)
    $victim_uid = array($vic_uid)
    $victim_name = array($vic_name)
    $victim_netid = array($vic_netid)
    $adversary_uid = array($adv_uid)
    $adversary_name = array($adv_name)
    $adversary_netid = array($adv_netid)
    $is_successful = max(if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 1))
    $result = if($is_successful > 0, "succeeded", "failed")
    $result_time = array($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $hostnames = array($e.principal.hostname)
    $process_file_paths = array($e.principal.process.file.full_path)
    $command_lines = array($e.principal.process.command_line)

  condition:
    $e
}

rule SDL_C_HOST_POTENTIAL_MULTI_STAGE_ATTACK {

  meta:
    author = "@notcmmartin"
    description = "Detects potential multi-stage attack activity by correlating multiple distinct detections associated with numerous MITRE ATT&CK tactics observed on a single hostname within a 4-hour window. Assigns a risk score based on average detection risk plus bonuses for observed pairwise chronological progression between tactic categories."
    severity = "HIGH"
    priority = "MEDIUM"
    alerting = "true"

  events:
    $id = $d.detection.id
    $type = $d.detection.type 
    $ruleName = $d.detection.detection.rule_name
    $ruleId = $d.detection.detection.rule_id
    $d.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"] != ""
    $hostname = $d.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.hostname
    
    match:
        $hostname over 10d

  outcome:
    $rule_name = array_distinct($d.detection.detection.rule_name)
    $ruleSetDisplayName = array_distinct($d.detection.detection.rule_set_display_name)
    $alerting_count = count_distinct(if($d.detection.detection.alert_state = "ALERTING",1,0))
    $detections_count = count_distinct(if($d.detection.detection.alert_state != "ALERTING",1,0))
    $curated_rules_count = count_distinct(if($d.detection.type = "GCTI_FINDING",1,0))
    // MITRE ATTACK
    $mitre_tactics = array_distinct($d.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"])
    $mitre_tactics_size = arrays.size($mitre_tactics)

    $mitre_initial_access_sequence = max(if($d.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"] = /TA0001/,$d.detection.created_time.seconds,0))
    $mitre_execution_sequence = max(if($d.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"] = /TA0002/,$d.detection.created_time.seconds,0))
    $mitre_persistence_sequence = max(if($d.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"] = /TA0003/,$d.detection.created_time.seconds,0))
    $mitre_privilege_escalation_sequence = max(if($d.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"] = /TA0004/,$d.detection.created_time.seconds,0))
    $mitre_defense_evasion_sequence = max(if($d.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"] = /TA0005/,$d.detection.created_time.seconds,0))
    $mitre_credential_access_sequence = max(if($d.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"] = /TA0006/,$d.detection.created_time.seconds,0))
    $mitre_discovery_sequence = max(if($d.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"] = /TA0007/,$d.detection.created_time.seconds,0))
    $mitre_lateral_movement_sequence = max(if($d.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"] = /TA0008/,$d.detection.created_time.seconds,0))    
    $mitre_collection_sequence = max(if($d.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"] = /TA0009/,$d.detection.created_time.seconds,0))
    $mitre_exfiltration_sequence = max(if($d.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"] = /TA0010/,$d.detection.created_time.seconds,0))
    $mitre_command_and_control_sequence = max(if($d.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"] = /TA0011/,$d.detection.created_time.seconds,0))


    $risk_score = math.floor(
        max($d.detection.detection.risk_score) * 0.5
        + sum($d.detection.detection.risk_score) / count($d.detection.detection.rule_id)
        // Add points only if BOTH tactics in the pair were observed AND are in sequence
        + if($mitre_initial_access_sequence > 0 and $mitre_execution_sequence > 0 and $mitre_initial_access_sequence <= $mitre_execution_sequence, 5, 0)
        + if($mitre_execution_sequence > 0 and $mitre_persistence_sequence > 0 and $mitre_execution_sequence <= $mitre_persistence_sequence, 5, 0)
        + if($mitre_persistence_sequence > 0 and $mitre_privilege_escalation_sequence > 0 and $mitre_persistence_sequence <= $mitre_privilege_escalation_sequence, 5, 0)
        + if($mitre_privilege_escalation_sequence > 0 and $mitre_defense_evasion_sequence > 0 and $mitre_privilege_escalation_sequence <= $mitre_defense_evasion_sequence, 5, 0)
        + if($mitre_defense_evasion_sequence > 0 and $mitre_credential_access_sequence > 0 and $mitre_defense_evasion_sequence <= $mitre_credential_access_sequence, 5, 0)
        + if($mitre_credential_access_sequence > 0 and $mitre_discovery_sequence > 0 and $mitre_credential_access_sequence <= $mitre_discovery_sequence, 5, 0)
        + if($mitre_discovery_sequence > 0 and $mitre_lateral_movement_sequence > 0 and $mitre_discovery_sequence <= $mitre_lateral_movement_sequence, 5, 0)
        + if($mitre_lateral_movement_sequence > 0 and $mitre_collection_sequence > 0 and $mitre_lateral_movement_sequence <= $mitre_collection_sequence, 5, 0)
        + if($mitre_collection_sequence > 0 and $mitre_exfiltration_sequence > 0 and $mitre_collection_sequence <= $mitre_exfiltration_sequence, 5, 0)
        + if($mitre_exfiltration_sequence > 0 and $mitre_command_and_control_sequence > 0 and $mitre_exfiltration_sequence <= $mitre_command_and_control_sequence, 5, 0)

    )


  condition:
    $d 
    and #ruleId > 1 
    and $mitre_tactics_size >= 3
    and $risk_score >= 70

}

rule windows_system_whoami_execution {
  meta:
    author = "@cmmartin"
    description = "Detects whoami.exe executed by the LOCAL SYSTEM account (NT AUTHORITY\\SYSTEM). This may indicate successful local privilege escalation."
    severity = "LOW"
    reference = "https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/009827ab2624370ded2cb8240ca2fe82af36e3a94cff1f8a2eac574b4b928c4e/behavior"
    alerting = "false"
    tactic = "TA0004" //Privilege Escalation
    technique = "T1033" //System Owner/User Discovery
    composite_detection_input = "true"
    composite_detection_category = "windows_process"

  events:

    // Match Windows process creation events
    $e.metadata.log_type = "WINDOWS_SYSMON"
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"

    // Condition 1: Process executed by LOCAL SYSTEM
    $e.principal.user.windows_sid = "S-1-5-18"

    // Condition 2: Process image is whoami.exe
    $e.target.process.file.full_path = /whoami\.exe$/ nocase

    $e.principal.hostname = $hostname

  match:
    $hostname over 1m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 10

  condition:
    $e
}

rule ws_non_majestic1M_domain_observed {

  meta:
    author = "cmmartin@"
    description = "Detects DNS activity where a host resolves domains not found within the Majestic Million list."
    severity = "Medium"
    creation_date = "2025-03-26"
    last_modified = "2025-03-26"
    references = "https://majestic.com/reports/majestic-million" 
    mitigations = "Investigate the host for malicious activity. Review DNS logs for other suspicious domains. Block the domain if confirmed malicious."
    false_positives = "Legitimate applications or services using newly registered or uncommon domains. Internal testing or development environments."
    priority = "LOW"
    status = "production"

  events:
    $answer = $e.network.dns.answers.name
    $hostIP = $e.principal.ip
    $hostName = $e.principal.hostname
    $tld = re.capture($e.network.dns.answers.name,`^.*\.(\w+)(?:$|\.$)`)
    $domain = re.capture($e.network.dns.answers.name,`^.*\.(.*?\.\w+)(?:$|\.$)`)
    not $domain in %Majestic_Million.Domain

match:
    $hostIP, $hostName, $domain, $tld, $answer over 1h

outcome:
    $total = count($e.metadata.id)
    $first_seen = timestamp.get_timestamp(min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds))
    $last_seen = timestamp.get_timestamp(max($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds))
    $risk_score = 0

  condition:
    $e
}

rule fusion_feed_djr_test_principal_process_file_md5 {
 meta:
   rule_name = "File Hash - Applied Threat Intelligence"
   description = "Matches file hashes against the Applied Threat Intelligence Fusion Feed."

 events:
   // Filter graph
   $context_graph.graph.metadata.product_name = "MANDIANT_FUSION_IOC"
   $context_graph.graph.metadata.vendor_name = "MANDIANT_FUSION_IOC"
   $context_graph.graph.metadata.entity_type = "FILE"
   $context_graph.graph.metadata.source_type = "GLOBAL_CONTEXT"

   // Do join
   $ioc = $context_graph.graph.entity.file.md5
   $ioc = $e1.principal.process.file.md5

 match:
   $ioc over 1h

 outcome:
   // Extract the Mandiant Automated Intel confidence score of maliciousness
   $confidence_score = max(if($context_graph.graph.metadata.threat.verdict_info.source_provider = "Mandiant Automated Intel", $context_graph.graph.metadata.threat.verdict_info.confidence_score, 0))
   // Extract the status of the indicator as seen in a breached environment
   $breached = max(if($context_graph.graph.metadata.threat.verdict_info.pwn = true, 1, 0))
   $global_hit_count = max(if($context_graph.graph.metadata.threat.verdict_info.source_provider = "Mandiant Global Intel", $context_graph.graph.metadata.threat.verdict_info.global_hits_count, 0))
   $type = array_distinct($context_graph.graph.metadata.threat.associations.type)
  
 condition:
   $e1 AND $context_graph
}

rule demoverse_Chrome_DLP_Egress_Activity_Blocks {

  meta:

    author = "Sam Eagle"
    description = "Alert on Block for DLP actions"
    severity = "Medium"

    //Excludes 'safe' sites such as dlptest.com. Covers paste and upload, with a higher
    //risk score assigned to pastes. Includes pastes to extensions.

  events:
    $dlp.metadata.product_event_type = "sensitiveDataEvent"
    $dlp.security_result.action_details = "EVENT_RESULT_BLOCKED"
    $dlp.security_result.about.labels.value = $method
    $dlp.target.file.size = $content_size
    $dlp.target.url = $target_url
    $dlp.target.url != /dlptest.com/
    $dlp.extracted.fields["profile_user"] = $userid


  outcome:
    $risk_score = max(
      if ($dlp.target.user.userid = "", 25,0) +
      if ($method = "", 10) +
      if ($method = "FILE_DOWNLOAD", 25) +
      if ($method = "PAGE_PRINT", 30) +
      if ($method = "FILE_UPLOAD", 35) +
      if ($method = "WEB_CONTENT_UPLOAD", 40)
        )

    $dlp_user = array_distinct($userid)
    $dlp_url = array_distinct($target_url)
    $dlp_local_user = array_distinct($dlp.target.user.userid)
    $dlp_method = array_distinct($method)
    $dlp_bytes = max($content_size)
    $dlp_sha256hash = array_distinct($dlp.target.file.sha256)

  condition:
    $dlp
}

rule demoverse_Chrome_DLP_CRX_Activity {

  meta:

    author = "Sam Eagle"
    description = "Alert on low volume pastes of sensitive data into extensions"
    severity = "Medium"

  events:
    $dlp.metadata.log_type = "CHROME_MANAGEMENT"
    $dlp.metadata.product_event_type = "sensitiveDataEvent"
    $dlp.additional.fields["transfer_method"] = "FILE_PASTE"
    $dlp.security_result.rule_name = /Audit low volume sensitive data copies/
    $dlp.security_result.rule_name != /Block Paste of Sensitive Content/
    $dlp.target.file.size > 1
    $dlp.target.file.size = $content_size
    //Look only for Chrome Extensions
    $dlp.target.url = /^chrome-extension/
    $dlp.target.url = $target_url
    $dlp.extracted.fields["profile_user"] = $userid

    re.capture($dlp.target.url, "chrome-extension://([^/]+)/") = $ext.target.resource_ancestors.product_object_id

    $ext.metadata.log_type = "CHROME_MANAGEMENT"
    $ext.metadata.product_event_type = "extensionTelemetryEvent"
    $ext.extracted.fields["profile_user"] = $userid
    $ext.target.resource.attribute.labels.value = "HTTP_HTTPS"
    $ext.target.resource_ancestors.product_object_id = $crx_obj

    $ext.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds >= $dlp.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds 

  match:
    $userid over 5m after $dlp

  outcome:
    //Since this is a five minute window, calculate the volume within the window.  Tried
    //a count but each $dlp event is joined with each extensionTelemetry event, acting as 
    //a multiplier on the count e.g., 1 paste to an extension with 2 HTTPS connections 
    $dlp_user = array_distinct($userid)
    $dlp_url = array_distinct($target_url)
    $dlp_local_user = array_distinct($dlp.target.user.userid)
    $dlp_method = "FILE_PASTE"
    $dlp_bytes = max($content_size)

    $risk_score = max(35)
    $extension = array($crx_obj)
    $Extension_Name = array_distinct($ext.target.resource_ancestors.name)
    $Target_Domains = array_distinct($ext.target.asset.hostname)

  condition:
    $dlp and $ext
}

rule demoverse_Chrome_Browser_Safe_Browsing_User_Bypass {
// This rule floats Chrome Safe Browsing findings and assigns a risk score

meta:
    author = "Sam the Eagle"
    description = "Triggered by Chrome Safe Browsing Event"
    severity = "Medium"

events:
    ($e.metadata.product_event_type = "badNavigationEvent" ) or

      if ($e.security_result.description = "SOCIAL_ENGINEERING", 45) +

        )

rule demoverse_Chrome_Browser_DLP_Warn_Alert {

    // This file tracks/audits those files that a user started to upload, was warned by a Data Protection rule in
    // Workspace, and then declined to proceed.  Because there is no exact tracking option for "Declined" this rule
    // uses nonexistence -- looking for the absence of EVENT_RESULT_BYPASSED while also using a sliding window where
    // the warning notice precedes the bypass action. Uses the file hash as the join to assure the same file is
    // in play at each stage

  meta:
    author = "Sam Eagle"
    description = "Tracks sensitive file upload where a user declined the event"
    severity = "Low"

  events:
    $dlp.metadata.product_name = "Chrome Management" 
    $dlp.metadata.product_event_type = "sensitiveDataEvent"
    $dlp.security_result.action_details = "EVENT_RESULT_WARNED"
    $dlp.security_result.about.labels["trigger_type"] = "FILE_UPLOAD"
    $dlp.security_result.rule_name != ""
    $dlp.target.url != /dlptest.com/
    $dlp.target.file.size > 1
    
    $dlp.target.file.sha256 = $nonexist.target.file.sha256

    $nonexist.metadata.product_name = "Chrome Management" 
    $nonexist.metadata.product_event_type = "sensitiveDataEvent"
    $nonexist.security_result.action_details = "EVENT_RESULT_BYPASSED"
    $nonexist.security_result.about.labels["trigger_type"] = "FILE_UPLOAD"
 
    $content_size = $dlp.target.file.size
    $target_url = $dlp.target.url
    $userid = $dlp.extracted.fields["profile_user"]
    $method = $dlp.security_result.about.labels["trigger_type"]
    $local_file = $dlp.target.file.full_path

  match:
      $userid over 1m after $dlp

  outcome:
    $dlp_user = array_distinct($userid)
    $dlp_url = array_distinct($target_url)
    $dlp_local_user = array_distinct($dlp.target.user.userid)
    $dlp_method = array_distinct($method)
    $dlp_bytes = max($content_size)
    $dlp_sha256hash = array_distinct($dlp.target.file.sha256)
    $dlp_local_file = array_distinct($local_file)
    $risk_score = 0

  condition:
    $dlp and !$nonexist
}

rule vt_sha256_malicious_verdict {

  meta:
    author = "@google_secops"
    description = "Alerts upon Target File Hashes (SHA256) marked as MALICIOUS using VT File Metadata enrichment."
    severity = "MEDIUM"
    priority = "HIGH"

    events:
        (
            $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_INJECTION" or
            $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or
            $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_MODULE_LOAD" or
            $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_OPEN" or
            $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION" or
            $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_TERMINATION" or
            $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_UNCATEGORIZED"                                                         
        )
        $e.target.process.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS"

        $e.principal.hostname = $hostname
        $e.principal.namespace = $namespace
        $e.target.process.file.sha256 = $sha256

        $namespace = "Cymbal"

    match:
        $hostname, $namespace over 10m

    outcome:
        $event_time = max($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
        $first_seen_time = max($e.target.process.file.first_seen_time.seconds)
        $first_seen_delta = cast.as_int(($event_time - $first_seen_time) / 86400)

        $risk_score = max(
            35
            // reduce / increase score based on VT File Metadata enriched severity        
            - if($e.target.process.file.security_result.severity = "LOW", 10, 0) 
            + if($e.target.process.file.security_result.severity = "MEDIUM", 0)
            + if($e.target.process.file.security_result.severity = "HIGH", 10, 0)
            // reduce / increase score based on Signed status
            - if($e.target.resource.attribute.labels["Signed"] = "true", 10, 0)
            + if($e.target.resource.attribute.labels["Signed"] = "false", 10, 0)
            // VT FileMetadata Tags
            + if(any $e.target.process.file.tags = "persistence", 5, 0)
            + if(any $e.target.process.file.tags = "detect-debug-environment", 1, 0)
            + if(any $e.target.process.file.tags = "self-delete", 5, 0)
            + if(any $e.target.process.file.tags = "checks-network-adapters", 2, 0)
            + if(any $e.target.process.file.tags = "checks-disk-space", 2, 0)
            + if(any $e.target.process.file.tags = "checks-cpu-name", 2, 0)
            + if(any $e.target.process.file.tags = "invalid-signature", 1, 0)
            + if(any $e.target.process.file.tags = "malware", 10, 0)
            )
            // More recent observation produce a higher risk score
            + if($first_seen_delta <= 1, 45, 0)                                   // <1 day
            + if($first_seen_delta <= 7 and $first_seen_delta > 1, 30, 0)         // <7 day    
            + if($first_seen_delta <= 30.44 and $first_seen_delta > 7, 10, 0)     // <30 day    
            + if($first_seen_delta <= 90 and $first_seen_delta > 30.44, 0, 0)     // <90 day
            + if($first_seen_delta > 90, 10, 0)                                 // >90 day

        $embedded_urls = array_distinct($e.target.process.file.embedded_urls)
        $tags = array_distinct($e.target.process.file.tags)

    condition:
        $e and $risk_score >= 70
}
rules.author: @google_secops

rule ueba_logins_from_unique_geos_30d {


  meta:
    // Allows for storage of arbitrary key-value pairs of rule details - who
    // wrote it, what it detects on, version control, etc.
    // The "author" and "severity" fields are special, as they are used as
    // columns on the rules dashboard. If you'd like to be able to sort based on
    // these fields on the dashboard, make sure to add them here.
    // Severity value, by convention, should be "Low", "Medium" or "High"
    author = "Global Security Architects"
    description = "Leverages metrics functions to find and report first-time logins from new geographic locations"
    severity = "Medium"

events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    $e.security_result.action = "ALLOW"
    $e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region != ""
    $e.metadata.base_labels.namespaces != "LogStory"
    $userid = $e.target.user.userid
    $location = $e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region
match:
    // find events from now - 4h ago, which is the recommended look-back period
    $userid, $location over 4h
outcome:
    $count_number_locations = count_distinct($location)
    $location_list = array_distinct($location)
    // check hourly analytics until daily analytics are available
    $first_seen_today = max(metrics.auth_attempts_success(
        period:1h, window:today, metric:first_seen, agg:max,
        target.user.userid:$userid, principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region:$location))
    $first_seen_monthly = max(metrics.auth_attempts_success(
        period:1d, window:30d, metric:first_seen, agg:max,
        target.user.userid:$userid, principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region:$location))
condition:
    $e and ($first_seen_today = 0) and ($first_seen_monthly = 0)
}

rule gcve_Windows_Domain_Controller_Admin_Downloads_and_Installed {
  // This rule is meant to flag on someone downloading a file from a web browser as an Administrator and then
  // executing it. Created to demonstrate for customers who lift and shift DCs into GCVE.  Narrow window of visibility
  // through having only Windows Events logged.

  meta:

    author = "Greg Kushmerek"
    description = "Catch Admins downloading files and immediately installing or running them"
    severity = "Medium"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "WINEVTLOG"
    $e.principal.user.userid = "Administrator"
    $e.principal.user.userid = $user

rule demoverse_suspicious_auth_unusual_interval_time {

    meta:
        author = "@cmmartin"
        description = "Generates a detection for authentication activity occuring between two locations in an unusual interval of time."
        severity = "LOW"
        priority = "LOW"

    events:
        $e1.metadata.log_type = "WORKSPACE_ACTIVITY"
        $e1.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
        $e1.metadata.product_event_type = "login_success"
        
        // match variables
        $user = $e1.security_result.about.email
        $e1_lat = $e1.principal.location.region_coordinates.latitude
        $e1_long = $e1.principal.location.region_coordinates.longitude

        // ensure consistent event sequencing, i.e., $e1 is before $e2
        $e1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds < $e2.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
        // check the $e1 and $e2 coordinates represent different locations
        $e1_lat != $e2_lat
        $e1_long != $e2_long

        $e2.metadata.log_type = "WORKSPACE_ACTIVITY"
        $e2.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"    
        $e2.metadata.product_event_type = "login_success"
        // match variables
        $user = $e2.security_result.about.email
        $e2_lat = $e2.principal.location.region_coordinates.latitude
        $e2_long = $e2.principal.location.region_coordinates.longitude
    
    match:
        $user, 
        $e1_lat, 
        $e1_long, 
        $e2_lat, 
        $e2_long 
        over 4h
    
    outcome:
        // calculate the interval between first and last event, in seconds
        $duration_hours = cast.as_int(
            min(
                ($e2.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - $e1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds) 
                / 3600
            )
        )

        // calculate distance between login events, and convert results into kilometers
        // - math.ceil rounds up a float up to the nearest int
        $distance_kilometers = math.ceil(
            max(
                math.geo_distance(
                    $e1_long,
                    $e1_lat,
                    $e2_long,
                    $e2_lat
                )
            ) 
            // convert the math.geo_distance result from meters to kilometers
            / 1000 
        )

        // calculate the speed in KPH
        $kph = math.ceil($distance_kilometers / $duration_hours)

        // // generate risk_score based on KPH, i.e., speed over distance travelled
        $risk_score = (
            if($kph >= 100 and $kph <= 249, 35) +
            if($kph > 250 and $kph <= 449, 50) +
            if($kph > 500 and $kph <= 999, 75) +
            if($kph >= 1000, 90)
        ) 

        // change this according to your requirements
        $risk_score_threshold = 75
    
    condition:
        $e1 and $e2 and $risk_score >= $risk_score_threshold
}

rule fusion_principal_process_file_md5 {

    meta:
        author = "cmmartin@"
        description = "Matches Fusion MD5 Hashes against UDM Process and File events."
        priority = "HIGH"
        severity = "MEDIUM"

    events:
        (
            $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
            or $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_MODULE_LOAD"
            or $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_CREATION"
        )
        $e.principal.process.file.md5 != "" 

        // Filter graph
        $g.graph.metadata.product_name = "MANDIANT_FUSION_IOC"
        $g.graph.metadata.vendor_name = "MANDIANT_FUSION_IOC"
        $g.graph.metadata.entity_type = "FILE"
        $g.graph.metadata.source_type = "GLOBAL_CONTEXT"

        $ioc = $e.principal.process.file.md5
        $ioc = $g.graph.entity.file.md5 

    match:
        $ioc over 1h

    outcome:
        // Extract the Mandiant Automated Intel confidence score of maliciousness
        $confidence_score = max(if($g.graph.metadata.threat.verdict_info.source_provider = "Mandiant Automated Intel", $g.graph.metadata.threat.verdict_info.confidence_score, 0))

        // Extract the status of the indicator as seen in a breached environment
        $breached = max(if($g.graph.metadata.threat.verdict_info.pwn = true, 1, 0))

        // Intermediary outcome variable to combine conditions of intelligence extracted in the previous outcome variables.
        // Return 1 if conditions are met, otherwise return 0.
        $matched_conditions = if($confidence_score >= 80 AND $breached = 1, 1, 0)

    condition:
        // Ensure $e, $g and $matched_conditions conditions are met.
        $e and $g and $matched_conditions = 1
}

rule fusion_target_ip {

    meta:
        author = "cmmartin@"
        description = "Matches external (non-RFC1918) UDM Target IP addresses against UDM Network Metadata Event Types.  Only match MATI Confidence Score of 80 and above."
        priority = "HIGH"
        severity = "MEDIUM"

    events:
        //UDM event types that will populate a principal and target IP address
        (
            $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION" or
            $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_DNS" or
            $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_HTTP" or
            $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_FLOW"
        )
        // match only target IP addresses that are not RFC1918
        (
            $dip = $e.target.ip 
            and $dip != "" 
            and not re.regex($e.target.ip, `(127(?:\.(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)){3}$)|(10(?:\.(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)){3}$)|(192\.168(?:\.(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)){2}$)|(172\.(?:1[6-9]|2\d|3[0-1])(?:\.(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)){2})`)
        )
        $e.principal.ip = $sip and $sip != ""

        // Filter graph
        $g.graph.metadata.product_name = "MANDIANT_FUSION_IOC"
        $g.graph.metadata.vendor_name = "MANDIANT_FUSION_IOC"
        $g.graph.metadata.entity_type = "IP_ADDRESS"
        $g.graph.metadata.source_type = "GLOBAL_CONTEXT"
        $dip = $g.graph.entity.ip

    match:
        $dip over 15m

    outcome:
        // Extract the Mandiant Automated Intel confidence score of maliciousness
        $confidence_score = max(if($g.graph.metadata.threat.verdict_info.source_provider = "Mandiant Automated Intel", $g.graph.metadata.threat.verdict_info.confidence_score, 0))

        $matched_conditions = if($confidence_score >= 80 AND $breached = 1, 1, 0)

    condition:
        // Ensure $e1, $context_graph and $matched_conditions conditions are met.
        $e and $g and $matched_conditions = 1
}

    author = "Sam Eagle"
    description = "Triggered by Chrome Safe Browsing Event"
    severity = "Medium"

events:
    ($e.metadata.product_event_type = "badNavigationEvent" ) or
    ($e.metadata.product_event_type = "dangerousdownloadEvent") or
    ($e.metadata.product_event_type = "contentTransferEvent") or
    ($e.metadata.product_event_type = "unscannedFileEvent")
    not $e.security_result.action_details = "EVENT_RESULT_BYPASSED"
    $e.security_result.category = $srDesc
    $e.principal.user.email_addresses = $userid

match:
    $userid over 5m

  outcome:
    
    $security_description = array_distinct($srDesc)
    $Instances = count_distinct($userid)
    $risk_score = max(
      if ($e.security_result.category_details = "", 10) +
      if ($e.security_result.category_details = "THREAT_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED", 15) +
      if ($e.security_result.category_details = "DANGEROUS", 20) +
      if ($e.security_result.category_details = "UNWANTED_SOFTWARE", 25) +
      if ($e.security_result.category_details = "SOCIAL_ENGINEERING", 30) +
      if ($e.security_result.category_details = "MALWARE", 35)
        )


  condition:
    $e and $risk_score > 10
}

rule ueba_userid_excessive_logins_failed {

  meta:
    description = "Detects excessive failed login events for a certain user."
    severity = "Low"
    priority = "Low"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    $e.security_result.action = "BLOCK"
    $e.target.user.userid = $userId
    //not $e.target.user.userid in %ueba_userid_exclusion

  match:
    $userId over 24h

  outcome:
    $daily_event_count = count($e.metadata.id)
    $max_daily_event_count = max(metrics.auth_attempts_fail(
      period:1d, window:30d,
      metric:event_count_sum,
      agg:max,
      target.user.userid:$userId))

    // detection feedback  
    $df_log_type = array_distinct($e.metadata.log_type)
    $df_product_event_type = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_event_type)
    $df_product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)    
    $df_asset = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.hostname)        
    $df_user = array_distinct($e.target.user.userid)

  condition:
    $e and ($daily_event_count > $max_daily_event_count)
}

rule vt_malicious_file_verdict {

  meta:
    author = "@cmmartin"
    description = "Matches UDM PROCESS_ Events against VT File Metadata Enrichment for known Malicious Verdicts."
    severity = "HIGH"
    priority = "HIGH"

  events:
    (
        $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or
        $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_OPEN" or
        $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_INJECTION" or
        $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_MODULE_LOAD" or
        $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_TERMINATION" or
        $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_UNCATEGORIZED"
    )
    $e.target.process.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS"
    $e.target.process.file.sha256 = $hash and $e.target.process.file.sha256 != ""        

    // placeholder variables     
    $e.principal.hostname = $asset
    $e.target.file.sha256 = $target_hash
    $e.target.user.userid = $user

  match:
    $asset over 1m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = max(
        75 +
        if($e.security_result.action = "ALLOW", 10) -
        if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 10)   
    )
    $oc_tags = array_distinct($e.target.process.file.tags)

  condition:
    $e
}

rule ueba_alerts_rule_name_by_principal_device {

  meta:
    author = "@cmmartin"
    description = "UEBA Detection for Vendor Alerts (Security Result Rule Name) above the historical baseline, by Alert and Asset."
    severity = "LOW"
    priority = "LOW"

  events:
    $rule_name = $e.security_result.rule_name and $rule_name != ""
    $e.metadata.product_name = "Microsoft-Windows-Eventlog"
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "Microsoft"
    $e.security_result.rule_name = "EventID: 1102"
    $asset = $e.principal.asset.hostname and $asset != ""

  match:
    $rule_name, $asset over 4h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $usage_past_24h = count($e.metadata.id)

    $avg_queries_per_day = max(
       metrics.alert_event_name_count(
            period:1d, 
            window:30d,
            metric:event_count_sum,
            agg:avg,
            principal.asset.hostname:$asset, 
            security_result.rule_name:$rule_name
        )
    )
    $min_queries_per_day = max(
       metrics.alert_event_name_count(
            period:1d, 
            window:30d,
            metric:event_count_sum,
            agg:min,
            principal.asset.hostname:$asset, 
            security_result.rule_name:$rule_name
        )
    )
    $max_queries_per_day = max(
       metrics.alert_event_name_count(
            period:1d, 
            window:30d,
            metric:event_count_sum,
            agg:max,
            principal.asset.hostname:$asset, 
            security_result.rule_name:$rule_name
        )
    )
    $intervals_in_baseline = max(
       metrics.alert_event_name_count(
            period:1d, 
            window:30d,
            metric:event_count_sum,
            agg:num_metric_periods,
            principal.asset.hostname:$asset, 
            security_result.rule_name:$rule_name
        )
    )
    $stddev_queries_per_day = max(
       metrics.alert_event_name_count(
            period:1d, 
            window:30d,
            metric:event_count_sum,
            agg:stddev,
            principal.asset.hostname:$asset, 
            security_result.rule_name:$rule_name
        )
    )
    $first_seen_monthly = max(
       metrics.alert_event_name_count(
            period:1d, window:30d, 
            metric:first_seen, 
            agg:sum,
            principal.asset.hostname:$asset, 
            security_result.rule_name:$rule_name
        )
    )

  condition:
    $e and $usage_past_24h > $avg_queries_per_day
}
rules.author: @cmmartin
